Water Table Depth, Sensor Technik Sirnach, ATM/N series (includes ATM/N, ATM/N/T, ATM/N/Ex, ATM/N/IS, ATM/NC, ATM.1ST/N, ATM.1ST/N19, ATM.1ST/N/T, ATM.1ST/N/Ex, ATM.ECO/N, ATM.ECO/N/Ex)
Water Table Depth, Sensor Technik Sirnach, PTM/N series (includes PTM/N, PTM/N/RS485, PTM/N/SDI12, PTM/N/Ex, PTM.MT/N/Ex)
Water Table Depth, Sensor Technik Sirnach, DTM.OCS.S/N
Water Table Depth, Trafag, ECL8438 family (includes all the 396 models starting with ECL8438)
Water Table Depth, TruTrack, WT-HR family (includes WT-HR-250, WT-HR-500, WT-HR-1000, WT-HR-1500, WT-HR-2000)

GRP_INST.name: INST_SN
GRP_INST.description: Serial number or other unique text string used to identify this instrument
GRP_INST.explanation: Report the serial number of the sensor that is unique for each single sensor. Use always the original SN if available; for some sensor this is mandatory: LI7200 (72H-xxxx), LI7550 (AIU-xxxx), HS sonics (Hxxxxxx) and CNR1 and CNR4 radiometers (xxxxxx). In case of probe treat each sensor as separated and assign a SN to each of them (e.g. adding _X to the probe SN); report in the comments that it is a probe and the model.

GRP_INST.name: INST_FIRMWARE
GRP_INST.explanation: Report the firmware of the instrument when available in the Purchase event (INST_FACTORY). In case of firmware updates use INST_FACTORY = Own repair

GRP_INST.name: INST_FACTORY
GRP_INST.description: Instrument factory purchase, calibration or repair. To be used also for laboratory activities.
GRP_INST.explanation: Use this variable to report the date when the instrument has been either purchased, repaired or calibrated in the factory. Use this variable also in case the sensor is repaired or calibrated in the lab or in the field without sending it to the factory. Select the appropriate option in the LIST to specify which type of operation or event is reported. Additional details can be provided in the COMMENT. The purchase date can be approximated if not known.

choices.description: Calibration of instrument by sending to the factory
Repair of damages to the instrument at the factory
Calibration of instrument made without sending it to the factory (includes lab and field calibration)
Repair of damages to the instrument made without sending it to the factory. Use this also for firmware update.
Purchase of the sensor

GRP_INST.name: INST_CALIB_FUNC
GRP_INST.description: Instrument calibration function in LaTex (included parameters)
GRP_INST.explanation:
Report in LaTex the equation and parameters for the conversion from instrument units (IU) to physical units. Use the appropriate option in INST_FACTORY to specify if the calibration function is the one at the purchase, provided after factory calibration or derived from site or lab calibrations. Contact the ETC for support and main functions already prepared. A tool online is also available at https://www.codecogs.com/latex/eqneditor.php
In case INST_MODEL is GA_CP-LI-COR LI-7200 or GA_CP-LI-COR LI-7200RS, only the coefficients are reported as in the calibration certificate starting with c for CO2 and w for H2O. Example: cA=1.342345E2 cB=-5.323454E4 cC=xxxx .... cXS=xxxx ... cSD1=xxxx wA=xxxxx wB=xxxxxx .... wSD3=xxxx
In case INST_MODEL is GA_SR-LI-COR LI-820, GA_SR-LI-COR LI-840 or GA_SR-LI-COR LI-840A, only the coefficients are reported as in the calibration certificate starting with c for CO2 and w for H2O. Example: ca1=1.342345E2 ca2=-5.323454E4 ca3=xxxx .... cXS=xxxx, cBB=xxxx, wa1=xxxxx wa2=xxxxxx ....

GRP_INST.name: INST_COMMENT
GRP_INST.description: Instrument comments (including specific model when not in the INST_MODEL list)
GRP_INST.explanation: Use this variable to report any other comment

GRP_INST.name: INST_DATE
GRP_INST.explanation: Starting date when the information submitted are valid (can be the submission date)

GRP_AGB.name: AGB_PLOT
GRP_AGB.description: Unique code of the CP or SP where AGB is measured
GRP_AGB.explanation: AGB_PLOT is linked to the PLOT_ID defined in the Sampling Scheme where the AGB is measured. It is a string followed by "_##"  where ## is the numeric ID (e.g. CP_01, or SP-I_01, always two digits). In case of SP-II-order points the numeric ID is composed by two numbers (##-$$) of two digits each where the first identifies the SP-I reference point (e.g. SP-II_01-02)

GRP_AGB.name: AGB_PLOT_TYPE
GRP_AGB.description: Only for Grassland: type of plot where AGB is measured
GRP_AGB.explanation: Only Grassland (mandatory). Select for the LIST the type of plot where AGB is measured. Valid options are all except Residue

choices.description: All the regular measurement points (only Grassland)
Grazing cage (only Grassland)
Stubble measurement (only Grassland)
Harvest residues (only Grassland)
Point in the grazed paddock, only if rotational grazing (only Grassland)
Cage in the grazed paddock, only if rotational grazing (only Grassland)

GRP_AGB.name: AGB_LOCATION
GRP_AGB.description: Only for Cropland and Forest: unique ID of the location inside the CP or SP-I where AGB is measured
GRP_AGB.explanation: Only Cropland and Forest. Cropland: assign a unique ID to each location inside the CP or SP-I where AGB is measured. The ID must be kept unique in time for the same AGB_PLOT. Forest: this is the ID of the location in the CP where the understorey AGB is measured (from 1 to 5)

GRP_AGB.name: AGB_LOCATION_HEIGHT
GRP_AGB.description: Only for Mires: height respect to the tower base of the plot where AGB is measured. See explanation.
GRP_AGB.explanation: Only Mires. Report the average height (respect to the tower base) of the plot where AGB is measured together with the canopy height (AGB_HEIGHTC). This information is used to calculate the vertical distance between EC system and canopy top. If zero can be left empty.

GRP_AGB.name: AGB_AREA
GRP_AGB.explanation: It is the area of the sample quadrat used for AGB measurements.

GRP_AGB.name: AGB
GRP_AGB.description: Above Ground Biomass corrected for area (AGB per square metre)
GRP_AGB.explanation: The Above Ground Biomass measured. AGB values measured should be scaled to area to report AGB per square metre (units gDM m-2). This is mandatory except if AGB_NPP_MOSS is reported.

GRP_AGB.name: AGB_HEIGHTC
GRP_AGB.description: Canopy height when AGB is measured (not for Forest)
GRP_AGB.explanation: Not valid for Forest. Height of the canopy measured with tape or stick when AGB is measured

GRP_AGB.name: AGB_NPP_MOSS
GRP_AGB.description: Only for Mires or Forest: report the yearly NPP of mosses
GRP_AGB.explanation: Only for Mires and for Forests if PTYPE is Moss. Report the yearly NPP of the Mosses measured using the brush wire method. In case this variable is reported, don't report AGB

GRP_AGB.name: AGB_PHEN
GRP_AGB.description: Phenological status of the plants where AGB is measured
GRP_AGB.explanation:
Report the phenological status of the AGB plant material reported for each measurement location.
Mandatory except for Grassland, Mires and Forests if AGB_NPP_MOSS is reported and for Sapling.

choices.description: Green vegetation
Not green vegetation (senescent, dead, woody etc., all that is not green)

GRP_AGB.name: AGB_SPP
GRP_AGB.description: Species for which AGB is measured and reported
GRP_AGB.explanation:
Only for Mires and Forest if AGB_TYPE is Sapling, optional for Grassland and Cropland. 
Report the species following the format explained in the Instructions for Plant Species Reporting. 
For Cropland use only to report species-level AGB of a multispecies crop mixture. To report AGB of a monospecific crop use AGB_PTYPE=Crop. Don't report if AGB_PTYPE is Weed.

GRP_AGB.name: AGB_PTYPE
GRP_AGB.description: Plant type or functional group for which AGB is measured
GRP_AGB.explanation: Not valid for Mires. Type of plants or functional group for which AGB is measured and reported. Refer to the Instructions for Ancillary Vegetation Measurements related to the ecosystem monitored to check the options requested.

choices.description: Crop species (only Cropland. The species is reported using the SPP group)
Weed species (only Cropland)
Moss species (only Forest)
Herbaceous species (only Grassland and Forest). In forest, this includes all herbaceous species (flowering and non-flowering), and grasses.
Shrubs, including dwarf shrubs (only Forest and Grassland)
Saplings (only Forest)
Ferns species (only Forest)
Leguminosae species (only Grassland)
Non-leguminosae species (graminoids and forbs) (only Grassland)
Graminoids species (only Grassland)
Non-leguminous forbs species (only Grassland)

GRP_AGB.name: AGB_ORGAN
GRP_AGB.description: Organ for which AGB is reported
GRP_AGB.explanation: Only for Cropland and for woody species in Mires. Report the organ for which the AGB is reported using one of the options in the LIST. Refer to the Instruction on Ancillary Vegetation Measurements for more information.

choices.description: Stems, including stalks and stems (only Cropland)
Leaves (only Cropland)
Flowers, including flowering structures (only Cropland)
Fruits, including seed-bearing organs, such as fruits, pods, siliques, ears, … (only Cropland)
Roots, including Roots or tubers (only Cropland)
Grains (only Cropland at harvest in grain crops)
Grain-bearing organs (only Cropland at harvest in grain crops)
Woody material (only Mires for the dwarf shrubs)
Non woody material (only Mires for the dwarf shrubs)

GRP_AGB.name: AGB_COMMENT
GRP_AGB.explanation: Use this variable also to give additional information and details about the AGB measurement.

GRP_BULKH.name: BULKH_PLOT
GRP_BULKH.description: Unique code of the SP where Bulk Height is measured
GRP_BULKH.explanation: Only for Grassland. BULKH_PLOT is linked to the SP-II PLOT_ID defined in the Sampling Scheme where the BULKH is measured. It is a string followed by two numbers (##-$$) of two digits each where the first identifies the SP-I reference point (e.g. SP-II_01-02). Note: this variable is present also in the template for the GAI. Doesn't have to be filled twice.

GRP_BULKH.name: BULKH_PLOT_TYPE
GRP_BULKH.description: Type of plot where Bulk Height is measured
GRP_BULKH.explanation: Only for Grassland. Select from the LIST the type of plot where BULKH is measured. For BULKH the possible valid options are Regular, Cage, Paddock or Paddock cage.

choices.description: All the regular measurement points (only Grassland)
Grazing cage (only Grassland)
Stubble measurement (only Grassland)
Harvest residues (only Grassland)
Point in the grazed paddock, only if rotational grazing (only Grassland)
Cage in the grazed paddock, only if rotational grazing (only Grassland)

GRP_BULKH.name: BULKH
GRP_BULKH.description: Bulk Height of vegetation measured with plate meter
GRP_BULKH.explanation: Only for Grassland. Report the bulk height of the vegetation measured using the plate meter

GRP_BULKH.name: BULKH_COMMENT
GRP_BULKH.explanation: Use this variable also to give additional information and details about the Bulk Height measurement.

GRP_BULKH.name: BULKH_DATE
GRP_BULKH.explanation: Date of  the Bulk Height measurement.

GRP_FLSM.name: FLSM_PLOT_ID
GRP_FLSM.description: Unique ID of the location where the sample has been collected
GRP_FLSM.explanation: The FLSM_PLOT_ID is linked to the PLOT_ID defined in the Sampling Scheme. It is a string followed by "_##"  where ## is the numeric ID (e.g. CP_01, or SP-I_01, always two digits). In case of SP-II-order points the numeric ID is composed by two numbers (##-$$) of two digits each where the first identifies the SP-I reference point (e.g. SP-II_01-02). In case of trees that has been agreed to be sampled and that are outside the CP, report Outside_CP and note that the tree must be also reported in the BADM_TREE. Refer to the Instruction on Foliar Sampling for information on which locations should be used in the different ecosystems.

GRP_FLSM.name: FLSM_TREE_ID
GRP_FLSM.explanation: The ID of the tree where the sample have been collected (all trees in the CP have an ID and also trees outside the CP that has been approved for sampling - TREE_ID variable). Valid only for forest.

GRP_FLSM.name: FLSM_SAMPLE_TYPE
GRP_FLSM.description: Type of material in the sample
GRP_FLSM.explanation: The type of vegetation material that is in the sample, selecting one of the options available in the controlled vocabulary.

choices.description: Only the leaves
Only the seeds
Only the fruits (seeds included)
The full plant (leaves, stem etc.)
Litterfall

GRP_FLSM.name: FLSM_SAMPLE_ID
GRP_FLSM.description: Unique ID of the sample for LMA and nutrients analysis
GRP_FLSM.explanation: The ID of the sample used either for nutrients determination or LMA calculation. The ID must be in general in the range from 1 and 30 (exceptions agreed with ETC). Since the measurements are paired the samples for LMA and nutrient availability share the same ID.

GRP_FLSM.name: FLSM_SPP
GRP_FLSM.explanation: Report here the species that has been sampled for nutrient analysis or LMA. Refer to the Instruction on species reporting for the format. Don't report if FLSM_PTYPE is reported.

GRP_FLSM.name: FLSM_PTYPE
GRP_FLSM.description: Plant type or functional group composing the sample (multiple species)
GRP_FLSM.explanation: Type of plants or functional group samples to prepare the sample that is a mix of species. Use only in agreement with the ETC and do not report if FLSM_SPP is reported (single species)

choices.description: Weed species (only Cropland)
Moss species
Herbaceous species (general)
Ferns species
Leguminosae species
Non-leguminosae species
Graminoids species
Non-leguminous forbs species

GRP_FLSM.name: FLSM_LMA_AREA
GRP_FLSM.description: Area of the sample used for the LMA calculation
GRP_FLSM.explanation: Area of the leaf sample collected to calculate the LMA

GRP_FLSM.name: FLSM_LMA_DW
GRP_FLSM.description: Dry mass of the sample used for LMA calculation
GRP_FLSM.explanation: Dry mass of the sample, dried at 65°C, collected to calculate the LMA.

GRP_FLSM.name: FLSM_COMMENT
GRP_FLSM.explanation: Use this variable also to give additional information and details about the method used.

GRP_PLOT.name: PLOT_ID
GRP_PLOT.explanation: The PLOT_ID is composed by the PLOT_TYPE string followed by "_##"  where ## is the numeric ID (e.g. CP_01, or SP-I_01, always two digits). In case of SP-II-order points the numeric ID is composed by two numbers (##-$$) of two digits each where the first identifies the SP-I reference point (e.g. SP-II_01-02).

GRP_PLOT.name: PLOT_TYPE
GRP_PLOT.explanation: The type of plot that is reported. It can be a Continuous Measurements Plot or a Sparse Measurements Plot of I order or II order. Use the options in the LIST

choices.description: Continuous Measurement Plot
I order Sparse Measurement Plot
II order Sparse Measurement Plot

GRP_PLOT.name: PLOT_EASTWARD_DIST
GRP_PLOT.description: Distance E-W of the center of the plot to the reference point
GRP_PLOT.explanation: Distance E-W between the center of the plot and the reference point. WEST of the reference point is negative. This variable must be submitted together with PLOT_NORTHWARD_DIST, PLOT_REFERENCE_POINT and PLOT_NORTHREF.

GRP_PLOT.name: PLOT_NORTHWARD_DIST
GRP_PLOT.description: Distance N-S of the center of the plot to the reference point
GRP_PLOT.explanation: Distance N-S between the center of the plot and the reference point. SOUTH of the reference point is negative.  This variable must be submitted together with PLOT_EASTWARD_DIST, PLOT_REFERENCE_POINT and PLOT_NORTHREF.

GRP_PLOT.name: PLOT_DISTANCE_POLAR
GRP_PLOT.description: Distance between the center of the plot and the reference point
GRP_PLOT.explanation: Distance, always positive, between the reference point and the center of the plot.  This variable must be submitted together with PLOT_ANGLE_POLAR, PLOT_REFERENCE_POINT and PLOT_NORTHREF.

GRP_PLOT.name: PLOT_ANGLE_POLAR
GRP_PLOT.description: Angle respect to N of the line center plot – reference point
GRP_PLOT.explanation: Angle respect to North (0-360) of the point position respect to the reference point. This variable must be submitted together with PLOT_DISTANCE_POLAR, PLOT_REFERENCE_POINT and PLOT_NORTHREF.

GRP_PLOT.name: PLOT_REFERENCE_POINT
GRP_PLOT.description: For SP-II-order points specifies if the reference point is tower or to the SP-I
GRP_PLOT.explanation: In case of SP-II points specifies if the reference point is the tower or the SP-I-order location around which the SP-II are identified

choices.description: The coordinates are related to the tower
The coordinates are related to the SP-I-order point

GRP_PLOT.name: PLOT_NORTHREF
GRP_PLOT.explanation: Specify if the North reference used to report the position of the plots is the Magnetic or the Geographic/True

choices.description: Angles or distances respect to Magnetic North
Angles or distances respect to True North (corrected for the magnetic declination)

GRP_PLOT.name: PLOT_LOCATION_LAT
GRP_PLOT.description: Latitude of the center of the plot to the tower
GRP_PLOT.explanation: Latitude of the center of the plot. This variable must be submitted together with PLOT_LOCATION_LONG.

GRP_PLOT.name: PLOT_LOCATION_LONG
GRP_PLOT.description: Longitude of the center of the plot to the tower
GRP_PLOT.explanation: Longitude of the center of the plot. This variable must be submitted together with PLOT_LOCATION_LONG.

GRP_PLOT.name: PLOT_HEIGHT
GRP_PLOT.description: Average height of the plot respect to the ground level at the tower
GRP_PLOT.explanation: Report the average height of the CP or SP plot respect to the basis of the tower where the EC system is mounted. If zero it is not needed to be reported. This variable is used to correctly calculate the canopy height respect to the EC system.

GRP_PLOT.name: PLOT_RECT_X
GRP_PLOT.description: Length of the shortest side in case of rectangular CP
GRP_PLOT.explanation: In case of rectangular CP (cropland, plantations, etc.) report the length of the shortest side of the plot

GRP_PLOT.name: PLOT_RECT_Y
GRP_PLOT.description: Length of the longest side in case of rectangular CP
GRP_PLOT.explanation: In case of rectangular CP (cropland, plantations, etc.) report the length of the longest side of the plot

GRP_PLOT.name: PLOT_RECT_DIR
GRP_PLOT.description: Orientation of the longest side in case of rectangular CP
GRP_PLOT.explanation: In case of rectangular CP (cropland, plantations, etc.) report the direction of the plot considering where the longest side is pointing

GRP_PLOT.name: PLOT_COMMENT
GRP_PLOT.explanation: Comments about the plot information reported

GRP_PLOT.name: PLOT_DATE
GRP_PLOT.explanation: Date about the plot information reported

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_PLOT
GRP_GAI.description: Unique code of the CP or SP where GAI is measured
GRP_GAI.explanation: GAI_PLOT is linked to the PLOT_ID defined in the Sampling Scheme where the GAI is measured. It is a string followed by "_##"  where ## is the numeric ID (e.g. CP_01, or SP-I_01, always two digits). In case of SP-II-order points the numeric ID is composed by two numbers (##-$$) of two digits each where the first identifies the SP-I reference point (e.g. SP-II_01-02)

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_PLOT_TYPE
GRP_GAI.description: Only for Grassland: type of plot where GAI is measured
GRP_GAI.explanation: Only Grassland (mandatory). Select from the LIST the type of plot where GAI is measured. For GAI the possible valid options are Regular or Stubble

choices.description: All the regular measurement points (only Grassland)
Grazing cage (only Grassland, only for Bulk height)
Stubble measurement (only Grassland, only for GAI measurements)
Harvest residues (only Grassland, only for harvest residues)
Point in the grazed paddock, only if rotational grazing (only Grassland, only for Bulk height)
Cage in the grazed paddock, only if rotational grazing (only Grassland, only for Bulk height)

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_LOCATION
GRP_GAI.description: Only for Cropland: ID of the location inside the CP or SP-I where GAI is measured. See explanation.
GRP_GAI.explanation:
Only Cropland. Assign an ID to each location inside the CP or the SP-I where GAI is measured either with ceptometer or by destructive sampling.
This variable must be used also to assign an ID to the locations where destructive and ceptometer measurements are performed for comparison (see Instruction Ancillary Vegetation Measurements in Cropland for more info). In this case use values starting from 10 and reporting as GAI_PLOT = CP_01 (even if the locations are not in CP_01).

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_LOCATION_HEIGHT
GRP_GAI.description: Only for Mires: height respect to the tower base of the plot where GAI is measured. See explanation.
GRP_GAI.explanation: Only Mires. Report the average height (respect to the tower base) of the plot where GAI is measured together with the canopy height (GAI_HEIGHTC). This information is used to calculate the vertical distance between EC system and canopy top. If zero can be left empty.

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_AREA
GRP_GAI.description: Area sampled for GAI measurements
GRP_GAI.explanation: Only Grassland and Cropland, when GAI_METHOD = Destructive. Optional for Mires. It is the area of the sample quadrat used for GAI measurements. For mires, fill when area is different from the standard area.

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_METHOD
GRP_GAI.description: Method used to measure GAI
GRP_GAI.explanation: Method used to measure the GAI. Use one of the options available in the LIST.

choices.description: AccuPAR LP-80 from Decagon Devices (only Cropland and Grassland)
SS1 SunScan Canopy Analysis System from Delta-T Devices (only Cropland, Grassland and Forest if agreed)
Digital Hemispherical Pictures (only Forest)
Destructive sampling.
Only for mosses, Green Area estimation (only Mires)
Only for herbaceous and dwarf shrub, modified Vascular Green Area method (only Mires)
Only when agreed with ETC, GAI estimation using spectral reflectance

GRP_GAI.name: GAI
GRP_GAI.description: Green Area Index measured (report here Green area for mosses in Mires)
GRP_GAI.explanation: Only when GAI_METHOD is Destructive, Visual estimation, Modified VGA or spectral reflectance. Value of the GAI measured as explained in the Instructions. For Mosses report here the Green Area. Can be reported per phenological status and plant type using the GAI_PHEN and GAI_PTYPE variables

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_HEIGHTC
GRP_GAI.description: Canopy height when GAI is measured
GRP_GAI.explanation: Not valid for Forest. Height of the canopy measured with tape or stick when GAI is measured.

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_PHEN
GRP_GAI.description: Only for comparison with ceptometer. Phenological status of plants where GAI is reported
GRP_GAI.explanation: Only for Grassland and Cropland. Only when GAI_METHOD = Destructive and the measurement is done for the comparison with the Ceptometer. Submit the two components (green and not-green) for each measurement location.

choices.description: Green vegetation
Not green vegetation (senescent, dead)

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_SPP
GRP_GAI.description: Species for which GAI is measured and reported
GRP_GAI.explanation: Only for Grassland, Mires, and Cropland. When the GAI is measured per species (please refer to the Instruction documents on Ancillary Vegetation), report the species following the format explained in the Instructions for Plant Species Reporting. For Cropland use only to report the species-level GAI of a multispecies crop mixture. To report the crop GAI of monospecific crop use GAI_PTYPE.

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_PTYPE
GRP_GAI.description: Plant type or functional group for which GAI is measured
GRP_GAI.explanation: Only for Grassland and Cropland. Only when GAI_METHOD is Destructive. Type of plants or functional group for which GAI is measured and reported. If the measurement is done without distinction among plants or functional groups leave empty. Refer to the Instructions for Ancillary Vegetation Measurements related to the ecosystem monitored to check the options requested.

choices.description: Crop species (only Cropland. The species name is reported using the SPP group)
Weed species (only Cropland)
Shrub and dwarf shrub species (only Grassland)
Leguminosae species (only Grassland)
Non-leguminosae species (graminoids and forbs) (only Grassland)
Graminoids species (only Grassland)
Non-leguminous forbs species (only Grassland)

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_DHP_ID
GRP_GAI.description: Only for DHP: ID of the DHP location inside the plot (see explanation)
GRP_GAI.explanation: Only Forest. Only when GAI_METHOD = DHP. Report here the ID of the location inside the plot where the photo is taken (see Instruction on Ancillary Vegetation Meas. in Forest) and the relative parameters of the GAI_DHP_ subgroup.

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_DHP_SLOPE
GRP_GAI.description: Only for DHP: average slope of the DHP photo location (see explanation)
GRP_GAI.explanation: Only Forest. Mandatory, only when GAI_METHOD = DHP. Report here the slope of the area around the point where the photo is taken (reported with GAI_DHP_ID, see Instr. on Ancillary Veg. Measurements in Forest). Must be reported together with GAI_DHP_ASPECT.  Report zero if the location is level.

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_DHP_ASPECT
GRP_GAI.description: Only for DHP: slope direction (aspect) of the DHP photo location (see explanation)
GRP_GAI.explanation: Only Forest. Mandatory, only when GAI_METHOD = DHP. Report here the slope direction of the area around the point where the photo is taken (reported with GAI_DHP_ID, see Instr. on Ancillary Veg. Measurements in Forest).  Must be reported together with GAI_DHP_SLOPE. Report 360 if the location is level.

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_DHP_EASTWARD_DIST
GRP_GAI.description: Distance E-W between the DHP location and the centre of the CP
GRP_GAI.explanation: Only Forest. Only when GAI_METHOD = DHP. Mandatory only when measurements are done in the CP and as alternative to GAI_DHP_DISTANCE_POLAR and GAI_DHP_ANGLE_POLAR. Distance E-W between the DHP position (reported with GAI_DHP_ID) and the centre of the CP. WEST of the reference point is negative. This variable must be submitted together with GAI_DHP_NORTHWARD_DIST.

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_DHP_NORTHWARD_DIST
GRP_GAI.description: Distance N-S between the DHP location and the centre of the CP
GRP_GAI.explanation: Only Forest. Only when GAI_METHOD = DHP. Mandatory only when measurements are done in the CP and as alternative to GAI_DHP_DISTANCE_POLAR and GAI_DHP_ANGLE_POLAR. Distance N-S between the DHP position (reported with GAI_DHP_ID) and the centre of the CP. SOUTH of the reference point is negative. This variable must be submitted together with GAI_DHP_EASTWARD_DIST and as alternative to GAI_DHP_DISTANCE_POLAR and GAI_DHP_ANGLE_POLAR.

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_DHP_DISTANCE_POLAR
GRP_GAI.description: Distance between the DHP location and the centre of the CP
GRP_GAI.explanation: Only Forest. Only when GAI_METHOD = DHP. Mandatory only when measurements are done in the CP and as alternative to GAI_DHP_NORTHWARD_DIST and GAI_DHP_EASTWARD_DIST. Distance, always positive, between the DHP position (reported with GAI_DHP_ID) and the centre of the CP. This variable must be submitted together with GAI_DHP_ANGLE_POLAR.

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_DHP_ANGLE_POLAR
GRP_GAI.description: Angle respect to N of the line centre CP – DHP location
GRP_GAI.explanation: Only Forest. Only when GAI_METHOD = DHP. Only when measurements are done in the CP and as alternative to GAI_DHP_NORTHWARD_DIST and GAI_DHP_EASTWARD_DIST. Angle respect to true North (0-360) of the DHP position (reported with GAI_DHP_ID) respect to the centre of the CP. This variable must be submitted together with GAI_DHP_DISTANCE_POLAR.

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_CEPT_ID
GRP_GAI.description: Only Forest: ID of the Ceptometer location inside the plot (see explanation)
GRP_GAI.explanation: Only Forest. Only when GAI_METHOD = SUNSCAN. Only when measurements are done in the CP. Report here the ID of the location inside the plot where the ceptometer measurement is taken (see Instruction on Ancillary Vegetation Meas. in Forest)

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_CEPT_EASTWARD_DIST
GRP_GAI.description: Only Forest: distance E-W between the ceptometer measurement and the centre of the CP
GRP_GAI.explanation: Only Forest. Only when GAI_METHOD = SUNSCAN. Only when measurements are done in the CP. Distance E-W between the DHP position and the centre of the CP. WEST of the reference point is negative. This variable must be submitted together with GAI_DHP_NORTHWARD_DIST and as alternative to GAI_DHP_DISTANCE_POLAR and GAI_DHP_ANGLE_POLAR. GAI_CEPT_ID must be also submitted.

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_CEPT_NORTHWARD_DIST
GRP_GAI.description: Only Forest: distance N-S between  the ceptometer measurement and the centre of the CP
GRP_GAI.explanation: Only Forest. Only when GAI_METHOD = SUNSCAN. Only when measurements are done in the CP. Distance N-S between the ceptometer measurement position and the centre of the CP. SOUTH of the reference point is negative. This variable must be submitted together with GAI_DHP_EASTWARD_DIST and as alterative to GAI_DHP_DISTANCE_POLAR and GAI_DHP_ANGLE_POLAR. GAI_CEPT_ID must be also submitted.

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_CEPT_DISTANCE_POLAR
GRP_GAI.description: Only Forest: distance between  the ceptometer measurement location and the centre of the CP
GRP_GAI.explanation: Only Forest. Only when GAI_METHOD = SUNSCAN. Only when measurements are done in the CP. Distance, always positive, between the ceptometer measurement position and the centre of the CP. This variable must be submitted together with GAI_DHP_ANGLE_POLAR and as alterative to GAI_DHP_NORTHWARD_DIST and GAI_DHP_EASTWARD_DIST. GAI_CEPT_ID must be also submitted.

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_CEPT_ANGLE_POLAR
GRP_GAI.description: Only Forest: angle respect to N of the line centre CP –  ceptometer measurement location
GRP_GAI.explanation: Only Forest. Only when GAI_METHOD = SUNSCAN. Only when measurements are done in the CP. Angle respect to true North (0-360) of the ceptometer measurement position respect to the centre of the CP. This variable must be submitted together with GAI_DHP_DISTANCE_POLAR and as alterative to GAI_DHP_NORTHWARD_DIST and GAI_DHP_EASTWARD_DIST. GAI_CEPT_ID must be also submitted.

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_COMMENT
GRP_GAI.description: GAI comments
GRP_GAI.explanation: Use this variable also to give additional information and details about the GAI measurement.

GRP_GAI.name: GAI_DATE
GRP_GAI.description: GAI measurement date
GRP_GAI.explanation: Date of  the GAI measurement. For Forests this is the date when DHP locations were determined (if no GAI values were entered).

GRP_CEPT.name: CEPT_ELADP
GRP_CEPT.explanation: Ellipsoid leaf angle distribution parameter (X; 0 or larger); only to be reported if GAI is measured with the SS1 Sunscan ceptometer.

GRP_CEPT.name: CEPT_ABSORP
GRP_CEPT.explanation: Leaf absorptivity of PAR (alpha; 0 to 1); only to be reported if GAI is measured with the SS1 Sunscan ceptometer

GRP_CEPT.name: CEPT_FIRST
GRP_CEPT.description: First diode/sector of ceptometer probe for comparison
GRP_CEPT.explanation: Only for ceptometer measurements made for comparison with destructive measurements in grasslands. First diode or segment of probe section inside the harvest quadrat. Must be submitted together with CEPT_LAST.

GRP_CEPT.name: CEPT_LAST
GRP_CEPT.description: Last diode/sector of ceptometer probe for comparison
GRP_CEPT.explanation: Only for ceptometer measurements made for comparison with destructive measurements in grasslands. Last diode or segment of probe section inside the harvest quadrat. Must be submitted together with CEPT_FIRST.

GRP_CEPT.name: CEPT_DATE
GRP_CEPT.explanation: Date of validity of ceptometer information. The parameters reported will be used for the ceptometer data processing from this date until a new value is submitted (with a new date).

GRP_BULKH.name: BULKH_PLOT
GRP_BULKH.description: Unique code of the SP where Bulk Height is measured
GRP_BULKH.explanation: Only for Grassland. BULKH_PLOT is linked to the SP-II PLOT_ID defined in the Sampling Scheme where the BULKH is measured. It is a string followed by two numbers (##-$$) of two digits each where the first identifies the SP-I reference point (e.g. SP-II_01-02). Note: this variable is present also in the template for the AGB. Doesn't have to be filled twice.

GRP_BULKH.name: BULKH_PLOT_TYPE
GRP_BULKH.description: Type of plot where Bulk Height is measured
GRP_BULKH.explanation: Only for Grassland. Select from the LIST the type of plot where BULKH is measured. For BULKH the possible valid options are Regular, Cage, Paddock or Paddock cage.

choices.description: All the regular measurement points (only Grassland)

Cage in the grazed paddock, only if rotational grazing (only Grassland, only for Bulk height)

GRP_BULKH.name: BULKH
GRP_BULKH.description: Bulk Height of vegetation measured with plate meter
GRP_BULKH.explanation: Only for Grassland. Report the bulk height of the vegetation measured using the plate meter

GRP_BULKH.name: BULKH_COMMENT
GRP_BULKH.explanation: Use this variable also to give additional information and details about the Bulk Height measurement.

GRP_BULKH.name: BULKH_DATE

GRP_SOIL_CHEM.explanation: The statistic for the measurement reported. Use predefined list (e.g., mean, min / max, standard deviation, etc).

choices.description: Minimum value
Quantile at 1% of distribution
Quantile at 5% of distribution
Quantile at 10% of distribution

Single observation

GRP_SOIL_CHEM.name: SOIL_CHEM_C_ORG_STATISTIC_METHOD
GRP_SOIL_CHEM.description: Soil organic carbon concentration statistic method
GRP_SOIL_CHEM.explanation: Method used to generate the reported statistic (e.g., aggregate of individuals, aggregate of sample aggregates) from observations representing the same time period. Use predefined list. The aggregation method is not meant to describe temporal aggregations for example in calculations of higher frequency observations (e.g., sub-minute) to lower frequency observations (e.g., hourly) at a single location.

choices.description: The statistic is aggregated from individual observations located within the site. Observations may be grouped into sample areas (e.g., plots) within the site but those groupings are ignored. Statistics generated from individual observations directly yield information on the site generally. The statistic may represent spatial characteristics of the measurement within the site (e.g., spatial heterogeneity) and/or characteristics due to other factors (e.g., population variability).

The statistic is aggregated from aggregated individual observations located in sample areas within the site. For example, individual observations are made in 5 sample plots within a site. "Aggregate of sample aggregates" is used if a plot statistic (e.g., Mean) is first calculated, and then the plot values are aggregated to calculate the site statistic. Statistics generated by this approach are often used to highlight the spatial characteristics within the site (i.e., the spatial heterogeneity of measurement within the site).
Estimate made by expert familiar with site

choices.description: Top of mineral soil not including organic layers
On top of all organic layers
See additional information in Approach / Comments

GRP_SWC.name: SWC_PROFILE_MIN
GRP_SWC.description: Soil water content profile minimum depth
GRP_SWC.explanation: Profile minimum depth is the vertical distance from profile zero reference to the top of soil layer being measured.

GRP_SWC.name: SWC_PROFILE_MAX
GRP_SWC.description: Soil water content profile maximum depth
GRP_SWC.explanation: Profile maximum depth is the vertical distance from profile zero reference to the bottom of soil layer being measured.

GRP_SWC.name: SWC_HORIZON
GRP_SWC.explanation: Use soil horizon scheme best suited for your soil. Examples include O, Oa, B, Bt, C.

GRP_SWC.name: SWC_DATE
GRP_SWC.explanation: Please report the date at the precision known. Allowed reporting precisions are YYYY, YYYYMM, YYYYMMDD, and YYYYMMDDHHMM. For soil moisture campaigns or temporal averages, SWC_DATE_START and SWC_DATE_END can be used.

GRP_SWC.name: SWC_DATE_START
GRP_SWC.description: Start date of Soil water content measurment
GRP_SWC.explanation: Start date of a soil moisure measurement campaign or start date of a temporal average. Please report the date at the precision known. Allowed reporting precisions are YYYY, YYYYMM, YYYYMMDD, and YYYYMMDDHHMM.

GRP_SWC.name: SWC_DATE_END
GRP_SWC.description: End date of Soil water content measurement
GRP_SWC.explanation: End date of a soil moisure measurement campaign or end date of a temporal average. Please report the date at the precision known. Allowed reporting precisions are YYYY, YYYYMM, YYYYMMDD, and YYYYMMDDHHMM.

GRP_SWC.name: SWC_DATE_UNC
GRP_SWC.description: Uncertainty in the Date(s) of Soil water content measurement

GRP_SOIL_WRB_GROUP.name: SOIL_WRB_GROUP
GRP_SOIL_WRB_GROUP.description: Soil Group for tower site according to the Soil World Reference Base for Soil Resources (WRB)
GRP_SOIL_WRB_GROUP.explanation: WRB (previously FAO) is a soil classification system. It describes soils with a two-level nomenclature comprising the name of a Soil Group and a modifying adjective that serves to identify a soil unit within a Group on the FAO Soil Map of the World. For the tower site, specify the Soil Group only from the predefined list. Do not report a modifying adjective. WRB_GROUP does not need to be reported if SOIL_ORDER is.

GRP_SOIL_WRB_GROUP.name: SOIL_WRB_GROUP_APPROACH
GRP_SOIL_WRB_GROUP.description: Approach used for assigning Soil WRB Group

GRP_SOIL_ORDER.name: SOIL_ORDER
GRP_SOIL_ORDER.description: Soil Order for tower site according to National Resource Conservation Service (NRCS) Soil Taxonomy
GRP_SOIL_ORDER.explanation: NRCS Soil Taxonomy is a soil classification system. It is based on soil properties as they appear in the field, such as presence and ordering of diagnostic horizons. Determine the Soil Order based on the appearance of the soil in the field. Choose the Order from the predefined list that best describes the dominant order within the tower site. SOIL_ORDER does not need to be reported if WRB_GROUP is.

GRP_SOIL_ORDER.name: SOIL_ORDER_APPROACH
GRP_SOIL_ORDER.description: Approach used for assigning Soil Order

GRP_SOIL_CLASSIFICATION.name: SOIL_CLASSIFICATION
GRP_SOIL_CLASSIFICATION.description: Soil Classification for tower site according to a taxonomy
GRP_SOIL_CLASSIFICATION.explanation: A more detailed description of the soil using a taxonomic system. Specify the taxonomy used in SOIL_CLASSIFICATION_TAXONOMY. Suggested taxonomies are NRCS and WRB (previously FAO). It is recommended to include texture, but not necessary. Two examples of Soil Classifications that includes texture are: fine, thermic Argixeroll and sandy, mixed, mesic Ultic Haploxeralf.

GRP_SOIL_CLASSIFICATION.name: SOIL_CLASSIFICATION_TAXONOMY
GRP_SOIL_CLASSIFICATION.description: Specify the taxonomy used for Soil Classification
GRP_SOIL_CLASSIFICATION.explanation: Use WRB (previously FAO) or NRCS as indicated in the predefined list. If you specify Other, report taxonomy in Approach.

choices.description: Previously FAO
See additional information in Approach / Comments

GRP_SOIL_CLASSIFICATION.name: SOIL_CLASSIFICATION_APPROACH
GRP_SOIL_CLASSIFICATION.description: Approach used for assigning Soil Classification

GRP_SOIL_SERIES.name: SOIL_SERIES
GRP_SOIL_SERIES.description: Soil Series for tower site according to a taxonomy
GRP_SOIL_SERIES.explanation: The Soil Series is a level in some taxonomies that describes a set of pedons with similar pedogenesis, soil chemistry, and physical properties. If using a taxonomy with a Soil Series level, it can be reported here. Specify taxonomy used in Approach.

GRP_SOIL_SERIES.name: SOIL_SERIES_APPROACH
GRP_SOIL_SERIES.description: Approach used for assigning Soil Series

GRP_SOIL_DEPTH.name: SOIL_DEPTH
GRP_SOIL_DEPTH.explanation: Report the depth (thickness) of the soil that is in theory accessible to the plant roots or up to the first rock layer as measured from the top of the litter layer. Define depth used in Approach.

GRP_SOIL_DEPTH.name: SOIL_DEPTH_STATISTIC
GRP_SOIL_DEPTH.explanation: The statistic for the measurement reported. Use predefined list (e.g., mean, min / max, standard deviation, etc).

choices.description: Minimum value
Quantile at 1% of distribution
Quantile at 5% of distribution
Quantile at 10% of distribution
Quantile at 25% of distribution
Median - Quantile at 50% of distribution
Quantile at 75% of distribution
Quantile at 90% of distribution
Quantile at 95% of distribution
Quantile at 99% of distribution
Maximum value
Average (mean) value of sample population
Standard deviation may be reported from a sample population that consists of individual or aggregated samples (observations). If the distinction is important, specify in Comments.

Report uncertainty as a plus or minus value in the measurement units. For example, enter 1.5 for +/- 1.5 units. Uncertainty may be reported from the instrument's specifications, determined empirically, or estimated by the tower team. Please describe such details in Approach. For uncertainty values that are better described by a range, a percent, or other, please enter information in Comments.
Single observation

GRP_SOIL_DEPTH.name: SOIL_DEPTH_STATISTIC_METHOD
GRP_SOIL_DEPTH.explanation: Method used to generate the reported statistic (e.g., aggregate of individuals, aggregate of sample aggregates) from observations representing the same time period. Use predefined list. The aggregation method is not meant to describe temporal aggregations for example in calculations of higher frequency observations (e.g., sub-minute) to lower frequency observations (e.g., hourly) at a single location.

choices.description: The statistic is aggregated from individual observations located within the site. Observations may be grouped into sample areas (e.g., plots) within the site but those groupings are ignored. Statistics generated from individual observations directly yield information on the site generally. The statistic may represent spatial characteristics of the measurement within the site (e.g., spatial heterogeneity) and/or characteristics due to other factors (e.g., population variability).

The statistic is aggregated from aggregated individual observations located in sample areas within the site. For example, individual observations are made in 5 sample plots within a site. "Aggregate of sample aggregates" is used if a plot statistic (e.g., Mean) is first calculated, and then the plot values are aggregated to calculate the site statistic. Statistics generated by this approach are often used to highlight the spatial characteristics within the site (i.e., the spatial heterogeneity of measurement within the site).
Estimate made by expert familiar with site

GRP_SOIL_DEPTH.name: SOIL_DEPTH_STATISTIC_NUMBER
GRP_SOIL_DEPTH.description: Number of observations used to determine soil depth statistic
GRP_SOIL_DEPTH.explanation: Number of observations (samples / replicates) used to calculate the STATISTIC for the reported measurement.

GRP_SOIL_DEPTH.name: SOIL_DEPTH_ORG
GRP_SOIL_DEPTH.explanation: Report the depth (thickness) of the organic soil horizon as measured from the top of the litter layer.

GRP_SOIL_DEPTH.name: SOIL_DEPTH_DATE
GRP_SOIL_DEPTH.explanation: Please report the date at the precision known. Allowed reporting precisions are YYYY, YYYYMM, YYYYMMDD, and YYYYMMDDHHMM.

GRP_SOIL_DEPTH.name: SOIL_DEPTH_DATE_UNC
GRP_SOIL_DEPTH.description: Uncertainty in the Soil depth measurement date

GRP_STO.name: STO_CONFIG
GRP_STO.description: Storage sampling scheme
GRP_STO.explanation: Select the used sampling scheme from the options in the respective LIST. It is mandatory when STO_TYPE = "Level installation". For more information refer to the Storage Instruction document.

choices.description: Separate sampling with multiple sensors (Option A)
Sequential sampling with a single sensor (Option B)
Simultaneous sampling with single sensor and mixing (Option C)

GRP_STO.name: STO_TYPE
GRP_STO.description: Operations, maintenance or event happening at the storage system (GA or Profile)
GRP_STO.explanation: Select the type of operation, maintenance or event done/happened to the instruments or profile system from the respective LIST options. This variable is linked to the others in the group. Either STO_PROF_ID in case if operations on the profile system, or STO_GA_MODEL (and STO_GA_SN) in case of operations on a GA. In case of firmware update the new firmware code should be reported using the INST_FIRMWARE variable. In case of change in logger, file or sampling interval use STO_TYPE = "Variable Map". Use STO_TYPE = "Level installation" to report specific level or characteristics, according to the variables in the STO_PROF subgroup. Use STO_TYPE = "Level removal" in case one level, or the full profile system, is removed. Use STO_TYPE = "GA installation" and "GA removal" for the gas analyser installation and removal. Use STO_TYPE = "Variable map" in case the same gas analyser is used for another gas (to be reported using STO_GA_VARIABLE).

choices.description: Disturbance to the instrument or storage system
Connection failure that didn't allow data transmission (but data are collected)
Calibration of an instrument in the field (adjust parameters)
Check of calibration of an instrument in the field
Cleaning an instrument, its parts or the storage system
Change of the filter in the tube
Firmware update
Installation of the gas analyzer in the field
Installation of level inlet(s)
Removal of level inlet(s)
General maintenance of instrument or the storage system
Replacement of parts of instruments
Removal of an gas analyzer from the station.
Change of the tube
Use this to report a general comment not fitting with the other options

Mapping of the instrument to one gas variable, to be used in case the same storage system measures more than one gas (report the gas using  STO_VARIABLE). In this case it is not needed to report again all the inlets and other info.

GRP_STO.name: STO_PROF_ID
GRP_STO.description: ID value identifying the profile system described. This is used to connect profile system and GA.
GRP_STO.explanation: This ID is used to link a profile with a GA. It is an arbitrary integer number used to univocally identify the profile system, defined as the system of tubes, buffer volumes and all the other components but the gas analyser (which is reported using the STO_GA group). The variable is required when whichever STO_PROF information is provided. In case of sequential sampling scheme is used with multiple GAs, the same ID (STO_GA_PROF_ID) must be used for the GA  that share the sampling lines. In case of separate sampling scheme, each level must have its own STO_PROF_ID.

GRP_STO.name: STO_PROF_LEVEL
GRP_STO.description: Sampling level number (reported in the raw data files)
GRP_STO.explanation: Level number is a progressive integer. It is unique for each level and starts with 1 for the top-most level. It is mandatory when STO_TYPE = "Level installation"

GRP_STO.name: STO_PROF_HEIGHT
GRP_STO.description: Sampling level height
GRP_STO.explanation: Profile level height. Use the organic-mineral horizons boundary (see Instruction on Soil Meteo) or the ground surface when not possible to identify it, as the 0 reference. It can be reported only when STO_TYPE = "Level installation" and together with STO_PROF_EASTWARD_DIST and STO_PROF_NORTHWARD_DIST.

GRP_STO.name: STO_PROF_EASTWARD_DIST
GRP_STO.description: Distance E-W from the site reference point. West of the reference point is negative.
GRP_STO.explanation: The east-west distance from the reference point (see Site Description Instruction). Use magnetic north as reference. When multiple points are used at the same level (inlet ramifications) consider the position of their geometric centre. It can be reported only when STO_TYPE = "Level installation" and together with STO_PROF_HEIGHT and STO_PROF_NORTHWARD_DIST.

GRP_STO.name: STO_PROF_NORTHWARD_DIST
GRP_STO.description: Distance N-S from the site reference point. South of the reference point is negative.
GRP_STO.explanation: The north-south distance from the reference point (see Site Description Instruction). Use magnetic north as reference. When multiple points are used at the same level (inlet ramifications) consider the position of their geometric centre. It can be reported only when STO_TYPE = "Level installation" and together with STO_PROF_HEIGHT and STO_PROF_NORTHWARD_DIST.

GRP_STO.name: STO_PROF_HORIZ_S_POINTS
GRP_STO.description: Number of sampling points at the sampling level
GRP_STO.explanation: When more sampling points are present at the same level (inlets ramification), report here their total number. It can be reported only when STO_TYPE = "Level installation"

GRP_STO.name: STO_PROF_BUFFER_VOL
GRP_STO.description: Buffer (mixing) volume
GRP_STO.explanation: Report the volume of the buffer connected to the level under consideration. This variable can be reported only when STO_TYPE = "Level installation"

GRP_STO.name: STO_PROF_BUFFER_FLOWRATE
GRP_STO.description: Nominal flow rate into the buffer volume
GRP_STO.explanation: The nominal flow rate of the air passing through the buffer volume. This variable can be reported only when STO_TYPE = "Level installation" or "Maintenance"

GRP_STO.name: STO_PROF_TUBE_LENGTH
GRP_STO.description: Tube length from the inlet to the buffer
GRP_STO.explanation: Length of the tube from the inlet to the buffer volume. This variable can be reported only when STO_TYPE = "Level installation"

GRP_STO.name: STO_PROF_TUBE_DIAM
GRP_STO.description: Inlet-to-buffer tube inner diameter
GRP_STO.explanation: Diameter of the tube from the inlet to the buffer volume. This variable can be reported only when STO_TYPE = "Level installation"

GRP_STO.name: STO_PROF_TUBE_MAT
GRP_STO.description: Inlet-to-buffer tube material
GRP_STO.explanation: Material of the tube from the inlet to the buffer volume. This variable can be reported only when STO_TYPE = "Level installation"

choices.description: Glass tube
Iron tube
Other type of tube
Teflon tube

GRP_STO.name: STO_PROF_TUBE_THERM
GRP_STO.description: Inlet-to-buffer tube thermal treatment
GRP_STO.explanation: Possible thermal treatment of the tube from the inlet to the buffer volume. This variable can be reported only when STO_TYPE = "Level installation" or "Maintenance"

choices.description: Heating installed
Insulation only
No thermal treatment

GRP_STO.name: STO_PROF_SAMPLING_TIME
GRP_STO.description: Length of the time interval of the measurement of the sampling level
GRP_STO.explanation: To be reported in case of STO_CONFIG = "Sequential" only. It is the length of the time of sampling of each single level (the time between two levels switch). This variable can be reported only when STO_TYPE = "Level installation" or "Maintenance"

GRP_STO.description: Model of the GA used for the storage measurement
GRP_STO.explanation: Report the model of the GA (must be one of the models listed in the INST group, in the availability of the station) selecting one of the models in the LIST(STO_INST). This variable is mandatory when any of the STO_GA variables is reported.
