GRP_SPPS.name: SPPS_PLOT
GRP_SPPS.description: Unique code of the CP or SP where the SPPS is found
GRP_SPPS.explanation:
The group can not submitted for Forest ecosystems. SPPS_PLOT is linked to the PLOT_ID defined in the Sampling Scheme where the species are classified. It is a string followed by "_##"  where ## is the numeric ID (e.g. CP_01, or SP-I_01, always two digits). In case of SP-II-order points the numeric ID is composed by two numbers (##-$$) of two digits each where the first identifies the SP-I reference point (e.g. SP-II_01-02).
In case of Cropland, when the species is the same in the whole target area, report it only associated to CP_01.
In case of Inaccessible Mires, when the species in the 100 locations along the boardwalk are reported, fill this variable always with SP-I_01 and then use SPPS_LOCATION to identify the points.

GRP_SPPS.name: SPPS_LOCATION
GRP_SPPS.description: Only for Inaccessible Mires: ID of the location where species are classified (see Explanation).
GRP_SPPS.explanation: Only Inaccessible Mires. When species along the boardwalk are identified, report the ID of the location along the boardwalk where the species are reported (from 1 to 100).

GRP_SPPS.name: SPPS_LOCATION_LAT
GRP_SPPS.description: Only Inaccessible Mires: latitude of the location along the boardwalk
GRP_SPPS.explanation: Only for Inaccessible Mires when the species along the  boardwalk are monitored in the 100 locations. Report the latitude of the location reported. To be reported together with SPPS_LOCATION_LON. When reported don't report SPPS_LOCATION_DIST and SPPS_LOCATION_ANG

GRP_SPPS.name: SPPS_LOCATION_LON
GRP_SPPS.description: Only Inaccessible Mires: longitude of the location along the boardwalk
GRP_SPPS.explanation: Only for Inaccessible Mires when the species along the  boardwalk are monitored in the 100 locations. Report the longitude of the location reported. To be reported together with SPPS_LOCATION_LAT. When reported don't report SPPS_LOCATION_DIST and SPPS_LOCATION_ANG

GRP_SPPS.name: SPPS_LOCATION_DIST
GRP_SPPS.description: Only Inaccessible Mires: distance between the tower and the location along the boardwalk
GRP_SPPS.explanation: Only for Inaccessible Mires when the species along the  boardwalk are monitored in the 100 locations. Report the distance measured between the tower and the location. To be reported together with SPPS_LOCATION_ANG. When reported don't report SPPS_LOCATION_LAT and SPPS_LOCATION_LON

GRP_SPPS.name: SPPS_LOCATION_ANG
GRP_SPPS.description: Only Inaccessible Mires: angle respect to N of the line tower – location along the boardwalk
GRP_SPPS.explanation: Only for Inaccessible Mires when the species along the  boardwalk are monitored in the 100 locations. Report the angle respect to true North of the direction tower to location. To be reported together with SPPS_LOCATION_DIST. When reported don't report SPPS_LOCATION_LAT and SPPS_LOCATION_LON

GRP_SPPS.name: SPPS
GRP_SPPS.explanation: Refer to the Instructions for Plant Species Reporting for more information on the format to be used.

GRP_SPPS.explanation: Only for Mires and only when SPPS_PLOT is a CP. Report the plant functional group of the species reported using the options available in the LIST. GRP_SPPS.explanation: Only for Mires. Projection cover expressed as the percentage of the plot area covered.

GRP_SOIL_TEX.explanation: Method used to generate the reported statistic (e.g., aggregate of individuals, aggregate of sample aggregates) from observations representing the same time period. Use predefined list. The aggregation method is not meant to describe temporal aggregations for example in calculations of higher frequency observations (e.g., sub-minute) to lower frequency observations (e.g., hourly) at a single location.

choices.description: The statistic is aggregated from individual observations located within the site. Observations may be grouped into sample areas (e.g., plots) within the site but those groupings are ignored. Statistics generated from individual observations directly yield information on the site generally. The statistic may represent spatial characteristics of the measurement within the site (e.g., spatial heterogeneity) and/or characteristics due to other factors (e.g., population variability).

The statistic is aggregated from aggregated individual observations located in sample areas within the site. For example, individual observations are made in 5 sample plots within a site. "Aggregate of sample aggregates" is used if a plot statistic (e.g., Mean) is first calculated, and then the plot values are aggregated to calculate the site statistic. Statistics generated by this approach are often used to highlight the spatial characteristics within the site (i.e., the spatial heterogeneity of measurement within the site).
Estimate made by expert familiar with site

GRP_SOIL_TEX.name: SOIL_TEX_ROCK_STATISTIC_NUMBER
GRP_SOIL_TEX.description: Number of observations used to determine rock content (>2mm) statistic
GRP_SOIL_TEX.explanation: Number of observations (samples / replicates) used to calculate the STATISTIC for the reported measurement.

GRP_SOIL_TEX.name: SOIL_TEX_PROFILE_ZERO_REF
GRP_SOIL_TEX.explanation: Profile Zero Reference is the horizontal plane from which the soil profile minimum and maximum depths are measured. For example, top of mineral soil or top of litter layer. Use predefined list.

choices.description: Top of mineral soil not including organic layers
On top of all organic layers
See additional information in Approach / Comments

GRP_SOIL_TEX.name: SOIL_TEX_PROFILE_MIN
GRP_SOIL_TEX.explanation: Profile minimum depth is the vertical distance from profile zero reference to the top of soil layer being measured.

GRP_SOIL_TEX.name: SOIL_TEX_PROFILE_MAX
GRP_SOIL_TEX.explanation: Profile maximum depth is the vertical distance from profile zero reference to the bottom of soil layer being measured.

GRP_SOIL_TEX.name: SOIL_TEX_DATE
GRP_SOIL_TEX.explanation: Please report the date at the precision known. Allowed reporting precisions are YYYY, YYYYMM, YYYYMMDD, and YYYYMMDDHHMM.

GRP_SOIL_TEX.name: SOIL_TEX_DATE_UNC
GRP_SOIL_TEX.description: Uncertainty in the Soil texture measurement date

GRP_SOIL_WRB_GROUP.name: SOIL_WRB_GROUP
GRP_SOIL_WRB_GROUP.description: Soil Group for tower site according to the Soil World Reference Base for Soil Resources (WRB)
GRP_SOIL_WRB_GROUP.explanation: WRB (previously FAO) is a soil classification system. It describes soils with a two-level nomenclature comprising the name of a Soil Group and a modifying adjective that serves to identify a soil unit within a Group on the FAO Soil Map of the World. For the tower site, specify the Soil Group only from the predefined list. Do not report a modifying adjective. WRB_GROUP does not need to be reported if SOIL_ORDER is.

GRP_SOIL_ORDER.name: SOIL_ORDER
GRP_SOIL_ORDER.description: Soil Order for tower site according to National Resource Conservation Service (NRCS) Soil Taxonomy
GRP_SOIL_ORDER.explanation: NRCS Soil Taxonomy is a soil classification system. It is based on soil properties as they appear in the field, such as presence and ordering of diagnostic horizons. Determine the Soil Order based on the appearance of the soil in the field. Choose the Order from the predefined list that best describes the dominant order within the tower site. SOIL_ORDER does not need to be reported if WRB_GROUP is.

GRP_SOIL_CLASSIFICATION.name: SOIL_CLASSIFICATION
GRP_SOIL_CLASSIFICATION.description: Soil Classification for tower site according to a taxonomy
GRP_SOIL_CLASSIFICATION.explanation: A more detailed description of the soil using a taxonomic system. Specify the taxonomy used in SOIL_CLASSIFICATION_TAXONOMY. Suggested taxonomies are NRCS and WRB (previously FAO). It is recommended to include texture, but not necessary. Two examples of Soil Classifications that includes texture are: fine, thermic Argixeroll and sandy, mixed, mesic Ultic Haploxeralf.

GRP_SOIL_CLASSIFICATION.name: SOIL_CLASSIFICATION_TAXONOMY
GRP_SOIL_CLASSIFICATION.description: Specify the taxonomy used for Soil Classification
GRP_SOIL_CLASSIFICATION.explanation: Use WRB (previously FAO) or NRCS as indicated in the predefined list. If you specify Other, report taxonomy in Approach.

choices.description: Previously FAO
See additional information in Approach / Comments

GRP_SOIL_SERIES.name: SOIL_SERIES
GRP_SOIL_SERIES.description: Soil Series for tower site according to a taxonomy
GRP_SOIL_SERIES.explanation: The Soil Series is a level in some taxonomies that describes a set of pedons with similar pedogenesis, soil chemistry, and physical properties. If using a taxonomy with a Soil Series level, it can be reported here. Specify taxonomy used in Approach.
